newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Banco Ganadero in expansion.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Banco Ganadero in expansion.

text.p: Colombia's Banco Ganadero announced plans to open 50 more branch offices across Colombia as part of an ambitious $30 million plan to retain its position as the country's largest commercial bank.

The bank, which already operates a 185-strong branch network across Colombia, will open the additional 50 offices this year and next according to Miguel Largacha, its vice president and general secretary.
"This is an important investment," Largacha told Reuters in a telephone interview, referring to the $30 million price-tag for expanding the branch network.
"Its part of our plan for improving our physical and technological infrastructure," he added.

Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya acquired a 40 percent stake of Ganadero's voting stock in August. As part of the deal, BBV assumed administrative control over the bank, which is Colombia's largest in terms of assets, and injected $208 million in fresh equity capital into the bank.
